description: Experience luxury and performance with this 2025 Cadillac XT5 4x4 Sport SUV in elegant white. Powered by a robust 3.6L V6 engine delivering 310hp and paired with a 9-speed shiftable automatic transmission, this XT5 features intelligent 4x4 capability for all-weather confidence. Enjoy advanced driver assistance with Front and Pedestrian Automatic Emergency Braking, Lane Keeping Assist with Blind Spot Integration, and Rear Cross Traffic Alert. Stay connected and entertained with the Cadillac Infotainment System, an 8-inch touchscreen, wireless Apple CarPlay & Android Auto, Wi-Fi hotspot, Bose Premium Audio, and Waze navigation app. The Enhanced Visibility and Technology Package provides a rearview camera, parking sensors, and more. Luxury abounds inside with leather-trimmed upholstery, heated front seats, tri-zone automatic climate control, a panoramic sunroof, and customizable digital displays. Convenience features include a sensor-activated power liftgate, remote engine start, power folding mirrors, and ample cargo space. description: Experience the power and sophistication of the 2025 Toyota Sequoia 4x4 Limited. With a robust 3.4L Hybrid Twin Turbo V6 engine delivering 437 hp, 10-speed shiftable automatic transmission, and advanced part-time 4WD, this SUV is ready for any adventure. Enjoy luxury and convenience with leatherette upholstery, heated and ventilated front seats, a panoramic 14-inch Toyota Audio Multimedia infotainment screen, wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, and built-in navigation with over-the-air map updates. Safety is paramount, featuring intersection/junction turn automatic emergency braking, pedestrian detection, blind spot monitoring, rear cross traffic alert, and a surround view camera system. Adaptive cruise control, power folding mirrors, power glass moonroof, and hands-free power rear liftgate enhance every drive. Perfect for families, the Sequoia offers spacious three-row seating, customizable digital instrument cluster, and multiple USB-C/USB power outlets throughout. Trailer stability control, Class IV hitch, and integrated trailer brake controller make towing a breeze. Don't miss this opportunity to own a top-tier, tech-forward SUV that combines power, safety, and comfort. description: Drive in style and confidence with this sleek gray 2025 Chevrolet Trax LT 4dr Crossover. Enjoy advanced connectivity with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, plus the convenience of remote engine start and push-button start. Safety comes first with front automatic emergency braking, lane keeping assist, pedestrian detection, and a rearview camera. Comfort features include automatic climate control, adjustable front and rear headrests, and a spacious 60/40 split rear seat. Stay connected with OnStar Guardian app compatibility, an 11-inch Chevrolet Infotainment System, Bluetooth, and SiriusXM radio. Practical touches like rear cupholders, ample cargo space with tie-down hooks, and a hard cargo cover make this Trax ready for everyday adventures. Across Allen, Noble, and DeKalb County, it feels planted, capable, and ready for whatever the day throws at it.  Finished with 20-inch gloss black aluminum wheels and bold black exterior accents, this F-150 carries a presence that doesnt ask for attention. It commands it.
